data.title: Federated GWAS
data.description: Genome-wide association study across institutions, computed with secure multi-party computation between one party per institution. The parties run on this platform and each fetches its institution's data product. Produces a Manhattan plot and an association table.

presets.title: Ultra fast
presets.description: First 1000 SNPs, QC only, no PCA. Fastest validation run.

presets.title: Quick
presets.description: First 10000 SNPs with QC and a light PCA.
